paragraphs.text: Neagley () is an American action crime television series created by Nick Santora and Nicholas Wootton for Amazon Prime Video. Based on the character Frances Neagley, created by Lee Child, it is a spin-off of the television series Reacher. It stars Maria Sten, who reprises her role from Reacher, alongside Greyston Holt, Adeline Rudolph, Jasper Jones, Matthew Del Negro, and Damon Herriman.
Neagley premiered its first season in its entirety on September 16, 2026. In October 2026, the series was renewed for a second season.

Frances Neagley, a private investigator based in Chicago, Illinois, seeks the truth after her childhood friend has died in a suspicious accident that leads her to Echo Canyon Farm, a peaceful cult-like commune that fronts an illegal human experimentation operation run by Lawrence Cole and Invection Pharmaceuticals CEO Pierce Woodrow.

The review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes reported a 94% approval rating, based on 31 critic reviews, with an average rating of 7.2/10. The website's critics consensus states, "Neagley isn't Reacher and it uses that to its advantage to chart its own thrilling path towards action hero greatness." Metacritic, which uses a weighted average, assigned a score of 67 out of 100 based on 15 critics, indicating "generally favorable reviews".
